item.title: Zotefoams: will tomorrow’s Trading Update give its shares, now 458p, some added bounce?
item.summary: Tomorrow morning, Wednesday, 5th August, the £229m-capitalised Zotefoams (LON:ZTF) will brief investors with its Interim Trading Update covering the six months to end-June – the statement should be positive enough to see the group’s shares some added bounce.
